findings.note: Barnes made 0 threes in 2 of his last 5 games (Nov 1 and Nov 2, 0-3 each) and took only 2-3 threes in four of those five, which leaves a real chance of a 0-make night; he made 1, 4 and 1 in the other three games.
When Barnes came back from his groin injury on Nov 15, he went 4-8 from three in 36 minutes, hit a step-back three to force overtime, and RotoWire expects him to be Toronto's No. 1 option on offense.

Barnes (groin) is due back Friday after a one-game absence, while RJ Barrett (hamstring) misses his second straight game and Kawhi Leonard is still out, so Barnes may have more shots to take, threes included.
